decisions.reason: The monthly target is established by a separate clause in the same message and is already represented by its INTRODUCE Event; changing the approval-trial batch to eight clips does not alter the 180-approved-clips monthly target.
The new trial count does not change the permitted source collection or source-exclusion rule.
The phrase '8 perfectg clips' does not establish or modify a concrete moment-selection standard.
The source changes the number and role of trial clips but does not modify the visual-editing guidelines.
The source does not state a new hook criterion or change the existing guideline-based hook standard.
Changing the trial batch to eight clips does not alter the required caption color treatment.
The source contains no decision about caption font selection.
The number of trial clips changes, but the 20-to-120-second duration rule remains valid unchanged.
The source does not change the requirement that each clip deliver its complete message or goal.
